symptoms: adb_available=true
adb devices output empty
no device / unauthorized / offline entries

steps: 先检查手机是否已通过 USB 线连接电脑

如果显示 unauthorized，转入 ADB_UNAUTHORIZED 方案

manual_required_actions: 插上手机 USB 线
手机亮屏解锁
选择 文件传输 / MTP
确认 USB 调试开启
必要时换 USB 线或 USB 口

symptoms: current page is S04_SERIES_LIST_PAGE
target series row is visible
model button is visible
actual clicked target is not 车型
page did not enter S05_MODEL_YEAR_TRIM_PAGE
root_cause: The S04 contract requires clicking only the right-side '车型' button inside the target series row. Clicking the series name or card breaks the contract and does not enter S05.
steps: On S04, never click the series name or the series card body.
Locate the target series row from the verified task context.
Locate the right-side '车型' button inside that same row or card.
Click only the '车型' button.
Recapture screenshot and UI XML after the click.
Verify entry into S05_MODEL_YEAR_TRIM_PAGE.
If the row exists but the button does not, raise SERIES_MODEL_BUTTON_NOT_FOUND.
If the button click still does not enter S05, raise MODEL_BUTTON_CLICK_NO_NAVIGATION.
manual_required_actions: Stop for manual confirmation if the target row is visible but the matching '车型' button cannot be located.
Stop for manual confirmation if clicking the verified '车型' button still does not enter S05.

symptoms: task trim and APP trim differ only by emission-standard spelling
国6 / 国Ⅵ / 国VI / 国六 variants are present
国5 / 国Ⅴ / 国V / 国五 variants are present
all non-emission trim text is otherwise identical
root_cause: Feishu task trim and APP trim may use equivalent Chinese emission-standard spellings while describing the same configuration.
steps: Normalize only the emission-standard token.
Map 国5/国Ⅴ/国V/国五 to 国V.
Map 国6/国Ⅵ/国VI/国六 to 国VI.
Allow the APP original trim node only when normalized task trim and normalized APP trim are exactly equal.
Write audit fields task_trim_raw, app_trim_raw, task_trim_normalized, app_trim_normalized, and emission_normalization_used=true.
manual_required_actions: If any non-emission text differs, stop for manual trim confirmation.

symptoms: adb_available=true
first adb devices -l output empty
user confirmed phone physically connected
previously the same device appeared as device
ADB server restart may recover enumeration
root_cause: ADB server state abnormal, USB device enumeration temporarily disconnected, phone connection session not refreshed, or Windows/ADB channel temporarily failed to recognize the device.
steps: When the first adb devices -l output is empty, do not enter APP flow.
Record ADB_TRANSIENT_DEVICE_NOT_FOUND and query the runtime knowledge base.
Execute adb kill-server once.
Execute adb start-server once.
Run adb devices -l again.
If device is restored, record ADB_TRANSIENT_DEVICE_NOT_FOUND_RECOVERED, write audit, and rerun task/device/app identity/page contract gates before continuing.
If still empty, record DEVICE_NOT_FOUND and stop for manual USB/MTP/cable/USB debugging authorization checks.
Before device state is device, launch, screenshot, XML, clicks, and collection are forbidden.
manual_required_actions: If recovery still shows no device, manually check USB connection, MTP/file transfer mode, data cable, USB port, and USB debugging authorization.
If recovery shows unauthorized, approve USB debugging RSA prompt on the phone.

symptoms: current page is S08_YEAR_SELECTION_PANEL or S08_AGE_EXACT_SLIDER_PANEL
year/age contract was generalized into ordinary age options or age ranges
left-side 车龄 tab or exact age slider contract was bypassed before execution
root_cause: S08 年款/车龄页面使用左侧车龄入口 + 右侧精确车龄滑块。把它理解成普通车龄选项或范围扫描属于契约漂移。
steps: 在 S08_YEAR_SELECTION_PANEL 先只读识别左侧“车龄”入口
未明确授权前不要点击左侧“车龄”
不要点击“不限车龄”
不要扫描普通车龄选项
进入 S08_AGE_EXACT_SLIDER_PANEL 后只识别精确滑块，不要把它当成范围
manual_required_actions: 如果左侧“车龄”或右侧滑块无法验证，人工确认页面结构。

symptoms: target task has registration_date_raw and vehicle_year
APP year/age panel uses an exact dual-handle age slider
three-same matching still needs exact year control
root_cause: The APP expresses year filtering through a dual-handle exact age slider instead of a direct vehicle-year option.
steps: Calculate target_age from registration_date_raw, vehicle_year, and current date.
Click the left-side 车龄 tab.
Detect the exact dual-handle age slider and track on the right side.
Read both left_handle_value and right_handle_value.
Set the left handle to target_age only when needed.
Set the right handle to target_age only when needed.
Verify left_handle_value == right_handle_value == target_age.
Keep requires_vehicle_year_secondary_check=true and re-check vehicle_year on the list page.
manual_required_actions: If the dual-handle slider cannot be verified or either handle cannot be set to the exact target age, stop for manual intervention.

symptoms: target age is 6
left handle is already set to 6
right handle is not yet 6
the current age filter is still a range instead of an exact value
root_cause: The exact-age panel uses a dual-handle slider. Exact success requires both handles to equal the same target age. Leaving the right handle at another value keeps the filter in a range state, not an exact single value.
steps: Detect both slider handles.
Read left_handle_value and right_handle_value.
Keep the left handle at target_age when it is already correct.
Move only the right handle to target_age.
Recapture screenshot and XML.
Verify left_handle_value == right_handle_value == target_age.
Keep requires_vehicle_year_secondary_check=true.
Do not click confirm or enter the vehicle list until exact validation succeeds.
manual_required_actions: If the right handle cannot be safely distinguished or cannot be set exactly to target_age, stop for manual review.

symptoms: XML right handle candidate was recognized as a tick, container, or edge instead of the green handle body
right_handle_actual_bounds or right_handle_actual_center is unreliable
right handle drag did not change the selected age range
root_cause: The runtime selected a structural XML node or tick/container node instead of the visual green right slider handle body.
steps: Bind handle detection to the S08 panel and slider track region.
Prefer green handle body-sized nodes that overlap the track and extend below it.
Reject unlimited tick, tick text, track edge, container edge, and background list nodes.
Record right_handle_actual_bounds and right_handle_actual_center.
Do not execute a real-device drag until this candidate is manually approved.
manual_required_actions: Review the before/after screenshot/XML and explicitly approve any next real-device right-handle drag.

symptoms: Right handle endpoint used the tick-6 text center or track centerline
The drag target y coordinate did not match the handle physical centerline
The right handle remained at unlimited after a short swipe
root_cause: Exact age success requires physical overlap of both handles. Using the tick label center as endpoint can miss the right handle control geometry.
steps: Use the left handle physical center as the right-handle drag endpoint.
Keep tick-6 bounds only as evidence that the target tick exists.
Record target_coordinate_source=left_handle_physical_center.
Do not execute the revised drag until manually approved.
manual_required_actions: Approve the revised right-handle target coordinate before any real-device drag.

symptoms: S08 slider XML contains background list text such as price, down payment, or vehicle-card copy
Background list nodes are close to the slider y band
Page recognition or handle recognition may be contaminated by non-panel nodes
root_cause: The foreground S08 panel and background list both appear in UIAutomator XML, so y-band-only filtering can choose non-slider nodes.
steps: Bind recognition to the S08 panel and slider structure.
Exclude price, down-payment, vehicle-title, and vehicle-card text nodes.
Require handle candidates to match visual handle body geometry.
Treat background list content as noise; do not trigger S07 flow or collection.
manual_required_actions: Review mixed XML evidence before approving any recovery that depends on visual coordinates.

symptoms: Short adb shell input swipe did not move the right handle
Right handle may require a longer press duration or drag gesture
Left handle must remain fixed at target_age
root_cause: The slider control may have touch slop, snapping, or anti-misoperation behavior that ignores short swipes.
steps: Only after manual approval, start from right_handle_actual_center.
Only after manual approval, end at left_handle physical center / overlap target.
Use a longer duration one time, then immediately recapture screenshot/XML.
Verify left=target_age, right=target_age, and physical overlap before any downstream action.
manual_required_actions: Explicitly approve any long-press drag parameters before real-device execution.

symptoms: foreground package remains com.ganji.android.haoche_c
focused window remains the Guazi business activity
mExpandedPanel still equals NotificationShade after two recovery rounds
isKeyguardShowing=false
mDreamingLockscreen=false
NotificationShade window animator reports isOnScreen=false
real-time screenshot shows the business page remains visible
root_cause: SystemUI keeps a residual NotificationShade expanded-panel reference even though the shade is no longer visually on-screen and focus/input remain on the Guazi business window. The current gate over-classifies this as a blocking overlay.
steps: When mExpandedPanel=NotificationShade persists, also verify focused window, keyguard flags, NotificationShade isOnScreen state, screenshot visibility, and fresh XML root package.

If focused window is the Guazi business activity, keyguard is false, NotificationShade isOnScreen=false, and screenshot/XML both show the business page, classify the state as residual NotificationShade rather than a blocking overlay.
Do not auto-approve business continuation from this candidate until a human explicitly approves the revised system-overlay rule.
If business continuation is not approved, prefer manual one-time notification-shade cleanup before resuming the flow.
manual_required_actions: Human approval is required before changing the gate from blocking to non-blocking for residual NotificationShade states.
If the shade still appears visually or any input interception is suspected, manually clear the notification shade once before resuming.

symptoms: S13 legal history-repair cell click did not enter S14
current_region=驾驶侧
click_target_text=左侧后门
history_repair_count=4
root_cause: The legal S13 history-repair cell is correct, but entering S14 depends on a narrow click mechanism that must stay inside the same validated cell and only vary the click point plus S14 after-check.
steps: Keep the same fresh S13 page and the same validated cell only.
Reconfirm the same parent cell, text bounds, and right-side icon bounds remain visible.
Try at most one approved click point per attempt, staying inside the same parent cell.
Use the approved click order: text center, parent center, then parent right safe zone.
After each click, fresh-check only whether S14 popup entered.
If S14 enters, stop immediately.
If all approved points fail, stop with LEARNING_LOOP_REQUIRES_HUMAN_REVIEW.
manual_required_actions: If the same S13 cell is no longer visible or its bounds drift outside the validated parent cell, require human review.
If three approved click attempts still do not enter S14, require human review.
